1. #### Modern slavery *
**Healthcare - Medical equipment**
This procurement category has a heightened risk of modern slavery.
You will be asked to provide information about modern slavery risks in your business and any actions you have taken to address these. You can visit the NSW Anti-slavery Commissioner’s [GRS webpage](https://dcj.nsw.gov.au/legal-and-justice/our-commissioners/anti-slavery-commissioner/due-diligence-and-reporting.html) for more information.

**Healthcare**
